title: Capture DWG ENDBLK callbacks and close ownerless fixed-space INSERT identities
scope: Carry exact parsed DWG block-footer identity into adapter state and verify source BLKREFS references against emitted INSERT, BLOCK, and ENDBLK records without accepting unknown owners.

reader.change: DwgEntityOutput::appendEndBlock now stages the parsed DRW_Block. Replay delivers addBlockEnd(data) and then endBlock(), attempting both callbacks even if one throws. The direct fallback also delivers addBlockEnd(data) before endBlock().
reader.compatibility: No DRW_Interface pure virtuals were added; addBlockEnd remains the existing callback.

adapter.change: An ownerless INSERT is admitted only when its ModelSpace/PaperSpace context matches the fixed-space block under validation. Unknown owner handles remain refused. Record inventory is enabled before write for source BLOCK_RECORD BLKREFS entries and is no longer overwritten by the later aggregate inventory setup.
adapter.transaction: The existing preflight refusal and destination transaction are retained.

coverage: Generated AC1015/AC1027 block-chain cases receive exact ENDBLK handles and owner handles through the staged reader path.
ASCII and Binary adapter cases refuse an unknown INSERT owner and preserve an existing destination sentinel.
The same adapter retries after correcting the INSERT owner to ownerless ModelSpace.
Fresh typed readback verifies one BLOCK_RECORD BLKREFS handle equals the emitted INSERT handle, the INSERT block name, ModelSpace and fixed BLOCK_RECORD owner.

physicalSource.result: Read succeeds with entityParseFailures=0 and objectParseFailures=0. Output passes BLOCK_RECORD planning and stops during TABLES emission at the empty-name STYLE 0xDF boundary. The source SORTENTSTABLE graph is printed as complete but its output is not reached. The nearby FIELDLIST message is a generic warning, not the failure cause.

validation.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was added; generated controls create and remove temporary output files.

limits: The receipt proves generated fixed-space INSERT and footer identity transport only; it does not qualify whole-file ET Border output.
The named-block SORTENTSTABLE remains refused under the established DXF owner-scope rule.
The AC1018 empty-name STYLE bit-order/source-disposition disagreement remains open; no omission, rename or parser-bit change is inferred.
No native CAD acceptance or support claim is promoted.
nextAction: Resolve the AC1018 empty-name STYLE source-layout disagreement, then continue the separately gated named-block SORTENTSTABLE and remaining P4 graph/output profiles.
